changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[ResponsibilityTypeMap] AS select R.ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.Name as ResponsibilityName, D.Name as ObjectName, D.Object, D.ObjectID from ResponsibilityTypeRelation R inner Join [dbo].[ResponsibilityType] RT on RT.ID = R.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join AssetType D on D.Object = R.ObjectType and D.ObjectID = R.ObjectID
